$comment: Generated by `python3 -m houseos.theme_kit build` from themes/. Do not edit.
title: A HouseOS theme's tokens.json (DTCG): only what differs from Base

neutral.description: Greys for grounds, text and lines; a hint of hue makes them feel chosen

accent.description: The one colour that means "act here" or "this is on"

private.description: Private or personal things (My Space, Nox's familiar)

surface.description: Sections, rails and cards that need a ground

selected.description: The chosen item in a list, tab or chip group

current.description: Where you are: the rail's room, the settings menu's page (a solid block with fg.current for an inverted look)

disabled.description: Controls that can't be used now

strong.description: Edges of controls (at least 3:1 on grounds)

focus-ring.description: The keyboard focus outline (at least 3:1 everywhere)

solid.description: Primary buttons, the active tab mark, progress
Private things: My Space, Nox's familiar

bg.description: Wall notes, the join card, the gazette

smart-home.description: Rooms without their own light in Base borrow a neighbour's; a theme may give each its own.

games.description: Its own light in every theme: a theme without one keeps Base's.

media-scrim.description: Under text laid over posters and covers

mono.description: Codes, times and numbers in tables

brand.description: The house's name in the status bar and the rail

cut.description: An optional clip-path for cut or notched corners on surfaces (none by default)

texture.description: An optional tiling image, url(...) from the theme's art/

rotate.description: Notes pinned slightly askew, e.g. 1.2deg (alternates per note)

overlay.description: Laid over art that carries text; the art itself is never tinted

fg.description: Text on the screen (a dark board in a light theme needs light text)

texture.description: e.g. scanlines for a CRT feel
A tiling image over the whole page, url(art/…)

scrim.description: Over the page.backdrop art, under the content: keep it strong enough for text

quiet.description: Behind quiet buttons (and toolbars' words) on the page: a fill when art shows behind the pages

ink-shadow.description: Under the page's own headings (titles, sections), for art behind the pages: e.g. 0 1px 3px #000

gallery.description: Behind rows and grids of posters and covers, so pictures never sit on the page's picture

art-opacity.description: How much the status.backdrop art shows (0–1)

ink-shadow.description: Under the rail's words when a rail picture (rail.surface) is behind them

fg.description: Its text: a dark bar in a light theme needs light text

kicker.description: The words above the title when the room has no light (unified rooms)

banner-fade.description: Where the header.banner art fades out, under the title

banner-wash.description: How strongly the room's light tints a header banner, fading down (0–1; 0 for none)

frame-texture.description: Drawn over the framed header's box: a bevel or gloss (a gradient), or url(art/…)

head.description: A panel's icon and link line

width.description: Home's picture on wide screens: how much of the greeting's box it takes, from the right

fade.description: How far into the picture it fades in from the words' side (of its own width)

bg.description: Buttons' ground: a colour, or a gradient over one (gloss, bevel)

primary-bg.description: The main button's ground: a colour, or a gradient over one

primary-shadow.description: The main button's shadow: an inset bevel, a glow

track.description: The empty part of a slider

pattern.description: Drawn over sliders and progress bars: segments, stripes or gloss (a gradient, or url(art/…))

thumb-radius.description: A slider's handle: round, or 0 for a square one
